limit: stopped_retention_seconds 3600 (account and service), configured 1 day, per-computer 7 days; the minimum applies
owners: synthetic account digests only; no owner account or host
soft_deletion: Snapshot objects are removed by the native snapshot sweeper about 1 hour after deletion; the buckets then keep soft-deleted generations for 7 days (retentionDurationSeconds 604800). These are stated separately from computer retention.
